syntax_quirks: tech slang and pop culture references

subtext_behavior.when_lying: Changes subject rapidly with misdirection humor and non-sequitur jokes
subtext_behavior.when_angry: ALL CAPS words sprinkled in, staccato bursts, drops punctuation
subtext_behavior.when_desperate: Loops the same phrase, voice cracks through repetition — 'come on come on come on'
subtext_behavior.when_guarded: Goes monosyllabic, answers only 'yep', 'nope', 'dunno' until pressed
subtext_behavior.when_mocking: Mimics the target's vocabulary in an exaggerated valley-girl register

backstory: Dropped out at fourteen after cracking his school district's grading server on a dare. Lives in a converted storage unit above a ramen shop and freelances pen-tests for anyone who pays in crypto. Still thinks he's invincible.
